source.title: Marker stewardship is still undocumented
source.body:
The requested follow-up to document marker stewardship has not been completed in the team manual.

**Why it matters:** Future contributors may lack guidance on maintaining this externally consumed marker format.

**Can wait:** The issue explicitly puts this documentation outside the current change and asks for it as a separate follow-up.

This is an intentionally out-of-scope follow-up, not a defect in the marker addition.
